title: Add Email/query Comparator type (RFC 8621 §4.4.2)
description: jmap-mail-server cannot implement Email/query ordering without a Comparator type. RFC 8621 §4.4.2 defines a Comparator object with: property (String, required), isAscending (bool, default true), collation (String, optional), and two Email-specific extension fields: keyword (String, optional — used when property is 'keyword') and mailbox (Id, optional — used when property is 'size' or 'receivedAt' within a mailbox context). Comparator is used in Email/query and Email/queryChanges.
design: Single struct EmailComparator. All fields except property are Option. isAscending defaults to true per the spec; use #[serde(default = true_fn)] or a custom default. The 'keyword' and 'mailbox' fields are RFC 8621-specific extensions to the base JMAP Comparator (RFC 8620 §5.5).
